title: Difference-in-Differences (DiD) · Propensity Score Matching (PSM) · Synthetic Control
prompt: When an A/B test is impossible (e.g., testing a policy change that must launch globally), compare quasi-experimental Causal Inference methods: **Difference-in-Differences (DiD)**, **Propensity Score Matching (PSM)**, **Synthetic Control**, **Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD)**, and **Instrumental Variables (IV)**.
subsection_title: A/B Testing, Causal Inference & Online Experimentation

resources.title: Difference-in-Differences
resources.why: Builds DiD from before/after and treated/control comparisons, with the parallel-trends assumption.

resources.title: Synthetic Control
resources.why: Weights control units to build a counterfactual when there is one treated unit.
